title: A bound-preserving oscillation-eliminating discontinuous Galerkin method with operator splitting for solving Kapila's five-equation model
summary: This paper proposes a robust operator-splitting discontinuous Galerkin (DG) framework to overcome the severe stiffness-induced instabilities in simulating compressible two-phase flows governed by Kapila's five-equation model with the Tammann equation of state. Specifically, the system is decoupled into a five-equation transport model and a stiff $κ$-source term.
